description: CLSI v1 checkpoint trees whose root is not usable, each named by the first rule an object of the tree breaks, met depth-first in child order (ledgerstore.md §7.4); a case breaking two adjacent rules pins their order. Each case is slots.root with S = 4096, whose slot 0 holds the root and whose slot 1 is zero, and one generation file {generation:D20}.clsi, of the root reference's generation. fileHex and rootFileHex run through the file's last non-zero byte; each file continues with zero bytes to its length (rootFile: 2 * 4096). Loading the files finds damage and no usable root, and rejects the one candidate root's tree for the case's reason.
